items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: No, only one P-Round was on the boat.

ctx.x: He sang. He made one record where he sang and the band backed him up. Back to Press. Did they ever have a violin on those bands?
No, only one P-Round was on the boat.
It was the only time. That's right.
